authorization: User requested extraction into decals, identified the new Karama motif, and instructed: do not replace, add.
sourceType: Solaris combines existing vector paths with source-traced engraving. Little Maker uses traced paths from supplied images. Karama 2.0 adapts the existing Karama vector.

tracing.normalization: Existing normalizeSvg and generate:vectors pipeline; inherited paint and transparent cutouts.

records.operation: Preserve the accepted star, native planet and lion, coin geometry and palette. Reduce portrait smoothing and restore fuller source-traced brow, eye, cheek and chin details. Use the supplied Emperor portrait as a visual guide and relax the collar grooves into less mechanical curves.

previousTrace.operation: Trace the four coin silhouettes and their cutout symbols from the perspective-corrected card photograph.

records.review: User suggested upscaling before tracing. Revised draft prepared for comparison; user approval is pending.

starGlyph.approval: User accepted the star. Preserve its geometry from commit 81b95a06ffb.

portrait.features: Retain the fuller source-traced brow, eye, cheek and chin curl. Use naturally curved collar grooves rather than straight parallel marks.
portrait.reference: emperor.jpg, used as a guide rather than a confirmed identification

additionalReference.interpretation: The user suggested the coin portrait may be inspired by the Emperor. Use the reference to guide fuller features and the military collar; this does not confirm the coin portrait identity.

reconstruction.review: Star accepted. Portrait uses less smoothing and fuller source features, with gently curved collar grooves. Portrait revision awaits visual approval.

records.operation: Trace the worm, pool ripples and engraved basin with subpixel smoothing. Preserve narrow light contours around the mouth, and remove the false notch in the left frame. The pale pool and engravings remain transparent cutouts.
records.approval: User said Little Maker is good on 23 October 2026; keep this artwork unchanged.

records.operation: Adapt the original eight kites and central octagon, preserving both concentric circular boundaries. Their intersections create the openings naturally. Retain seven original ray-glyph contours; use thin, irregular hill and dune ridgelines in the east point.
records.method: Clone the original Karama vector and adapt its geometric construction; no raster-traced glyph contours.

glyphReuse.north: Original Leo contour; translate outward 7.5 units.
glyphReuse.northEast: Original ring contours; scale 0.85 and translate [5.3, -5.3].
glyphReuse.east: Two thin, irregular hill and dune ridgelines with tapered ends and unequal peaks. Their overlaps form the small enclosed spaces; the curves replace the regular zigzag in variant A.
glyphReuse.southEast: Original cup contours; scale 0.95 and translate [5.3, 5.3].
glyphReuse.south: Original diamond contours; scale 0.95 and translate outward 9 units.
glyphReuse.southWest: Original figure-eight contours; scale 0.95 and translate [-5.3, 5.3].
glyphReuse.west: Original eye contours; scale 0.85 and translate outward 7 units.
glyphReuse.northWest: Original arch contours; scale 0.85 and translate [-5.3, -5.3].

records.authorization: User directed a clone of the original vector, then identified the missing second circle and requested inspection of an upscaled source.

inspection.finding: The second dark circle joins the ray bases. Its exposed arcs bound the small openings; replacing these with individual triangles loses the circular construction.

variants.name: A
variants.scope: Exact user-requested checkpoint before refining the hills. Circle and star construction accepted; the eastern glyph still needs refinement.

hillRefinement.scope: Only the contours inside ray-east change. The other path components and the kite outline remain unchanged.
hillRefinement.geometry: Cubic Bezier ridgelines with variable widths and tapered ends, outlined and united into filled paths.
hillRefinement.approval: User approved the refined hills and requested their use in the new Karama card and as a separate vector.

widthAdjustment.scope: Increase the width around the same centreline curves in both Karama and the standalone decal. Preserve tapered ends and enclosed gaps.

records.operation: Trace separate ink and olive layers over pale infill, with transparent outer corners. Remove isolated dark texture specks smaller than eight native pixels outside the worm region; preserve the small mouth marks. Colours approximate the supplied deck sheet, rather than measured print inks.
records.approval: User said Little Maker is good on 23 October 2026; keep this artwork unchanged.

records.operation: Extract the approved glyph subpaths from ray-east, excluding the kite body. Preserve all contours and internal spaces; fit the viewBox to the glyph bounds.
records.approval: User requested a separate new vector after approving the refined hills.

records.operation: Use the same refined coin geometry with near-black faces and pale cream engraving and rim bands, matching the supplied bitmap. Pale regions are opaque; the exterior remains transparent.
records.limitation: The sampled palette reflects the supplied bitmap; it does not measure the physical print inks.
records.approval: Star accepted. Portrait refinement awaits visual approval; bitmap-matched palette retained.

paletteSampling.method: Median RGB in each selected pixel group
